{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|I did hear that a ship had 'trouble' on the way here, but there isn't much information from the Port Authority. I think that there's a good reason to worry.|[[Selan Ellison]]|<ref name="SWG:SC">{{SWGcite|exp=RotW|type=general|Shuttle Crash|Naboo}}</ref>}}
'''Port Authorities''' were government institutions that supervised [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] operations. For a nominal fee, a Port Authority could provide precise [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] jump coordinates to [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] traveling along established [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]]. The Authority could also provide jump coordinates to more remote destinations if the customer provided accurate navigational data, or if the Authority had to plot the course themselves they would charge an expensive surcharge.<ref name="SWS">''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]''</ref> During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Port Authorities were under the authority of the [[Imperial Transit Authority/Legends|Imperial Transit Authority]].<ref name="SWG:SC" />

Examples of Port Authorities included the [[Coruscant Port Authority/Legends|Coruscant Port Authority]],<ref name="Collector">{{TCWComicCite|6.42|The Collector}}</ref> the [[Corellian Port Authority]],<ref name="SWG:SC" /> the [[Foless Spaceport Authority]],<ref name="TCW:SA">''[[The Clone Wars: Strange Allies]]''</ref> the [[Manaan Port Authority]].<ref name="KotOR">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref> the [[Teguta Lusat Port Authority]],<ref name="LCatMoS">''[[Lando Calrissian and the Mindharp of Sharu]]''</ref> the [[Tasariq Port Authority]],<ref name="TTCP">{{JournalCite|15|Tasariq: The Crystal Planet}}</ref> the [[Elrooden Starport Port Authority]],<ref name="OE">[[Operation: Elrood (book)|''Operation: Elrood'']]</ref> the [[Charbi Port Authority]],<ref name="Sacrifice">''[[Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice]]''</ref> and the [[Bestine Port Authority]].<ref name="SG">''[[Shadow Games]]''</ref>
